name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After recital J – Am 16
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: Ja. whereas both parties have demonstrated a firm commitment to the Paris Agreement, the UN 2030 Agenda and the core International Labour Organization conventions; whereas the political project known as the Fourth Transformation (4T), initiated under President Andrés Manuel López Obrador and continued by President Claudia Sheinbaum, is grounded in the fight against corruption, the reduction of poverty and the reversal of neoliberal policies, objectives that are broadly convergent with EU values of social cohesion and inclusive growth; whereas strengthening institutional ties between the EU and the Mexican Government is essential for translating these shared values into concrete, measurable outcomes for workers, communities and ecosystems on both sides;
